name: AMEA Edge Cache Rules
description: Cache static assets on both hosts; cache anonymous public GET HTML and media honoring origin Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control headers; fail closed to bypass on staff, non-GET, sessioned, and stateful routes.

rules.description: Cache versioned and unversioned GET/HEAD static assets under /assets/ on both public and staff hosts regardless of cookies
Cache anonymous public GET pages, published journal covers, and carousel photos using origin CDN-Cache-Control headers (bypassing any response without cache headers)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "aeesgs.org") and (http.request.method eq "GET") and not (http.cookie contains "AMEA_PUBLIC=" or http.cookie contains "AMEA_STAFF=" or http.cookie contains "PHPSESSID=") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.php" "/legal-notice.php" "/journal.php" "/journal-article.php" "/journal-cover.php"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/uploads/slider/"))

rules.description: Fail-closed final rule: never cache administration host routes, non-GET requests, sessioned browsers, or stateful public workflows (exempting GET/HEAD /assets/)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"aeesgs.org" "admin.aeesgs.org"}) and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and ((http.host eq "admin.aeesgs.org") or (http.request.method ne "GET") or (http.cookie contains "AMEA_PUBLIC=" or http.cookie contains "AMEA_STAFF=" or http.cookie contains "PHPSESSID=") or (http.request.uri.path in {"/register.php" "/registration-details.php" "/registration-preview.php" "/kyc-correction.php" "/accept-cgu.php"}))
